messages.content:
You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
national_gallery | National Gallery Singapore | 25 | 150 | 10:00-19:00 | -
bird_paradise | Bird Paradise | 49 | 180 | 09:00-18:00 | -
universal_studios | Universal Studios Singapore | 83 | 480 | 10:00-19:00 | -
orchid_garden | National Orchid Garden | 15 | 60 | 08:30-19:00 | -
supertree_grove | Supertree Grove | 0 | 45 | 05:00-24:00 | -
artscience | ArtScience Museum | 30 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
haw_par_villa | Haw Par Villa | 0 | 90 | 09:00-20:00 | -
cable_car | Singapore Cable Car | 35 | 45 | 08:45-22:00 | -
national_museum | National Museum of Singapore | 15 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
national_gallery: bird_paradise 46, universal_studios 23, orchid_garden 22, supertree_grove 14, artscience 13, haw_par_villa 29, cable_car 21, national_museum 12
bird_paradise: national_gallery 46, universal_studios 52, orchid_garden 37, supertree_grove 49, artscience 48, haw_par_villa 43, cable_car 47, national_museum 44
universal_studios: national_gallery 23, bird_paradise 52, orchid_garden 26, supertree_grove 23, artscience 23, haw_par_villa 24, cable_car 15, national_museum 24
orchid_garden: national_gallery 22, bird_paradise 37, universal_studios 26, supertree_grove 26, artscience 24, haw_par_villa 22, cable_car 21, national_museum 20
supertree_grove: national_gallery 14, bird_paradise 49, universal_studios 23, orchid_garden 26, artscience 12, haw_par_villa 32, cable_car 23, national_museum 16
artscience: national_gallery 13, bird_paradise 48, universal_studios 23, orchid_garden 24, supertree_grove 12, haw_par_villa 31, cable_car 22, national_museum 14
haw_par_villa: national_gallery 29, bird_paradise 43, universal_studios 24, orchid_garden 22, supertree_grove 32, artscience 31, cable_car 21, national_museum 29
cable_car: national_gallery 21, bird_paradise 47, universal_studios 15, orchid_garden 21, supertree_grove 23, artscience 22, haw_par_villa 21, national_museum 21
national_museum: national_gallery 12, bird_paradise 44, universal_studios 24, orchid_garden 20, supertree_grove 16, artscience 14, haw_par_villa 29, cable_car 21

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

Hey, I’ve got 5 hours and 55 minutes to kill starting at 09:00 and a budget of S$72. I need to hit up Supertree Grove, Singapore Cable Car, and Haw Par Villa—make sure to do the Cable Car before Haw Par Villa. If I can fit more in, I’d love to see National Gallery Singapore, Bird Paradise, Universal Studios Singapore, National Orchid Garden, ArtScience Museum, and National Museum of Singapore too.

response:
```python
import json
import z3

def solve():
    places = {
        "national_gallery": {"cost": 25, "duration": 150, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
        "bird_paradise": {"cost": 49, "duration": 180, "open": 540, "close": 1080},
        "universal_studios": {"cost": 83, "duration": 480, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
        "orchid_garden": {"cost": 15, "duration": 60, "open": 510, "close": 1140},
        "supertree_grove": {"cost": 0, "duration": 45, "open": 300, "close": 1440},
        "artscience": {"cost": 30, "duration": 90, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
        "haw_par_villa": {"cost": 0, "duration": 90, "open": 540, "close": 1200},
        "cable_car": {"cost": 35, "duration": 45, "open": 525, "close": 1320},
        "national_museum": {"cost": 15, "duration": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140}
    }

    travel_times = {
        "national_gallery": {"bird_paradise": 46, "universal_studios": 23, "orchid_garden": 22, "supertree_grove": 14, "artscience": 13, "haw_par_villa": 29, "cable_car": 21, "national_museum": 12},
        "bird_paradise": {"national_gallery": 46, "universal_studios": 52, "orchid_garden": 37, "supertree_grove": 49, "artscience": 48, "haw_par_villa": 43, "cable_car": 47, "national_museum": 44},
        "universal_studios": {"national_gallery": 23, "bird_paradise": 52, "orchid_garden": 26, "supertree_grove": 23, "artscience": 23, "haw_par_villa": 24, "cable_car": 15, "national_museum": 24},
        "orchid_garden": {"national_gallery": 22, "bird_paradise": 37, "universal_studios": 26, "supertree_grove": 26, "artscience": 24, "haw_par_villa": 22, "cable_car": 21, "national_museum": 20},
        "supertree_grove": {"national_gallery": 14, "bird_paradise": 49, "universal_studios": 23, "orchid_garden": 26, "artscience": 12, "haw_par_villa": 32, "cable_car": 23, "national_museum": 16},
        "artscience": {"national_gallery": 13, "bird_paradise": 48, "universal_studios": 23, "orchid_garden": 24, "supertree_grove": 12, "haw_par_villa": 31, "cable_car": 22, "national_museum": 14},
        "haw_par_villa": {"national_gallery": 29, "bird_paradise": 43, "universal_studios": 24, "orchid_garden": 22, "supertree_grove": 32, "artscience": 31, "cable_car": 21, "national_museum": 29},
        "cable_car": {"national_gallery": 21, "bird_paradise": 47, "universal_studios": 15, "orchid_garden": 21, "supertree_grove": 23, "artscience": 22, "haw_par_villa": 21, "national_museum": 21},
        "national_museum": {"national_gallery": 12, "bird_paradise": 44, "universal_studios": 24, "orchid_garden": 20, "supertree_grove": 16, "artscience": 14, "haw_par_villa": 29, "cable_car": 21}
    }

    must_visit = ["supertree_grove", "cable_car", "haw_par_villa"]
    optional_visit = ["national_gallery", "bird_paradise", "universal_studios", "orchid_garden", "artscience", "national_museum"]
    all_places = list(places.keys())

    start_time = 540  # 09:00
    end_time = 540 + 355  # 5 hours 55 minutes = 355 minutes -> 14:55 (895)
    budget = 72

    s = z3.Solver()

    visits = {}
    for p in all_places:
        visits[p] = z3.Bool(f"visit_{p}")
        
    starts = {}
    ends = {}
    for p in all_places:
        starts[p] = z3.Int(f"start_{p}")
        ends[p] = z3.Int(f"end_{p}")

    # Must-visit constraints
    for p in must_visit:
        s.add(visits[p])

    # Budget constraint
    cost_expr = sum(z3.If(visits[p], places[p]["cost"], 0) for p in all_places)
    s.add(cost_expr <= budget)

    # Time bounds and duration constraints for visited places
    for p in all_places:
        duration = places[p]["duration"]
        p_open = places[p]["open"]
        p_close = places[p]["close"]
        
        s.add(z3.Implies(visits[p], starts[p] >= p_open))
        s.add(z3.Implies(visits[p], ends[p] <= p_close))
        s.add(z3.Implies(visits[p], ends[p] == starts[p] + duration))
        s.add(z3.Implies(visits[p], starts[p] >= start_time))
        s.add(z3.Implies(visits[p], ends[p] <= end_time))

    # Cable car before Haw Par Villa constraint
    s.add(z3.Implies(z3.And(visits["cable_car"], visits["haw_par_villa"]), 
                     ends["cable_car"] + travel_times["cable_car"]["haw_par_villa"] <= starts["haw_par_villa"]))

    # No overlap and travel time constraints between any two visited places
    for p1 in all_places:
        for p2 in all_places:
            if p1 != p2:
                t_travel = travel_times[p1][p2]
                s.add(z3.Implies(
                    z3.And(visits[p1], visits[p2]),
                    z3.Or(ends[p1] + t_travel <= starts[p2],
                          ends[p2] + travel_times[p2][p1] <= starts[p1])
                ))

    if s.check() == z3.sat:
        m = s.model()
        result = []
        for p in all_places:
            if is_true(m.eval(visits[p])):
                result.append({
                    "location_id": p,
                    "start": m.eval(starts[p]).as_long(),
                    "end": m.eval(ends[p]).as_long()
                })
        # Sort by start time just to be neat
        result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
        print(json.dumps(result))
    else:
        print("UNSAT")

def is_true(val):
    return val is not None and bool(val)

solve()
```
